Что такое Таро.title: What Is Tarot
Что такое Таро.text: Tarot is a deck of 78 cards used for divination, self-discovery and reflection on life situations. Each card carries its own symbolic meaning, and their combination in a spread helps you look at a question from a new angle.

Немного истории.title: A Little History
Немного истории.text: The first tarot decks appeared in Italy in the 15th century as ordinary playing cards for the aristocracy. An esoteric meaning was attributed to them much later, in the 18th–19th centuries, in France and England. The best-known deck today, Rider–Waite–Smith, created in 1909, is the basis of the images this app uses.

Структура колоды.title: Structure of the Deck
Структура колоды.text: The deck is divided into the Major Arcana (22 cards) — big life themes and archetypes such as the Fool, Death or the Wheel of Fortune — and the Minor Arcana (56 cards), which describe everyday situations. The Minor Arcana are divided into four suits: Wands (energy, action), Cups (feelings, relationships), Swords (thoughts, conflict) and Pentacles (the material world, work, money).

Прямое и перевёрнутое положение.title: Upright and Reversed
Прямое и перевёрнутое положение.text: A card that falls upright usually points to a clear, active expression of its meaning. A reversed card more often indicates a blocked, internal or distorted version of the same meaning — a delay, resistance or a lesson that is still to be learned.

Как читать расклад.title: How to Read a Spread
Как читать расклад.text: In a spread, it is not only the individual card that matters but also its position — the position sets the question the card answers (“Past”, “Your Feelings”, “Outcome” and so on). Try to look at the cards not one by one but as a single story: how they complement or contradict each other.

Одна карта.title: One Card
Одна карта.text: The quickest spread — one card answers a specific question. It suits moments when you need a short, clear pointer.

Три карты.title: Three Cards
Три карты.text: The classic “Past — Present — Future” layout. It shows how the situation developed, what is happening now and where everything is heading.

Отношения.title: Relationship
Отношения.text: Six cards reveal the heart of a relationship: the state of each partner, their feelings for each other and the couple’s overall outlook.

Подкова.title: Horseshoe
Подкова.text: Seven cards in an arc — past, present, hidden influences, obstacle, environment, advice and outcome. Good for analyzing a particular situation as it develops.

Кельтский крест.title: Celtic Cross
Кельтский крест.text: The most detailed spread, with ten cards. It reveals the situation from every side: the heart of the matter, the obstacle, past, future, conscious and subconscious attitudes, the influence of the surroundings, hopes and fears, and the outcome.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
paragraphs: Tarot Oracle is a local app. It does not connect to the internet and does not send any data to external servers.
All data (reading history, settings, the card of the day) is stored only on your device, in a local database file (tarot.db) next to the app itself.
The app does not collect personal data, does not use analytics and does not show ads.
You can delete your reading history at any time, entirely or entry by entry, in the “History” section.
Uninstalling the app or deleting the tarot.db file will irreversibly erase all saved data — backups are not created automatically.

terms.title: Terms of Use
paragraphs: Tarot Oracle is intended for entertainment and meditative purposes. Card interpretations are conventional and symbolic in nature and are not professional advice — psychological, medical, financial or legal.
Decisions made on the basis of reading results remain entirely at the user’s discretion and responsibility.
The app is provided “as is”, without any guarantee of uninterrupted operation or freedom from errors.
The interpretations of the cards are based on the classical meanings of Tarot and are intended for general information.
By using the app, you agree that the developer is not responsible for any decisions or consequences related to the use of reading results.

Вопрос перед раскладом.title: Question Before a Spread
Вопрос перед раскладом.text: Before a spread begins, a window opens where you can choose a ready-made question by category (General, Love, Career, Finances, Health) or write your own. You can also begin a spread without any question.

Толкование карты.title: Card Interpretation
Толкование карты.text: Tapping any card opens the details: keywords, the general meaning and separate tabs — love, career, finances, health, advice.

📖 Толкование расклада.title: 📖 Spread Reading
📖 Толкование расклада.text:
The book icon at the bottom opens the “Reading” panel — a detailed breakdown of the spread. At the top is the “Overview of the Spread” block (for spreads of three or more cards), and below it is the interpretation of each card by its position.

The overview contains:
• How many Major Arcana the spread has and which suit dominates or is missing — this shows the scale of the question and the main area of life.
• Elements: every suit has an element (Wands — Fire, Cups — Water, Swords — Air, Pentacles — Earth), and the Major Arcana have theirs, following the Golden Dawn tradition. The app shows which element leads, which is missing and how the elements combine — whether they support each other or clash.
• Positions: what the key places in the spread mean (“Outcome”, “Obstacle”, “Advice”, “Past”, “Future” and others) and which cards fell there, upright or reversed.
• Reversed cards, court cards (people in the situation), aces (new beginnings) and tens (endings).
• Numerology: the card numbers are added up and reduced to a single digit (11 and 22 stay as special numbers). Court cards count like this: Page — 2, Knight — 3, Queen — 4, King — 5; the Fool (0) is not counted. If a number repeats, it is a theme running through the whole spread.
• “Advice from the spread” — a short conclusion drawn from all of the above: the tempo (act or wait), the main focus and one or two nuances.

The analysis is built automatically by rules, so the same spread always gets the same result. The same block is included in the image when you save a spread.

📝 Добавление комментария.title: 📝 Adding a Note
📝 Добавление комментария.text: After the card of the day, a single card or a spread, a notepad icon appears at the bottom. Tapping it opens a window where you can write your own note — for example, how things actually turned out. The note is saved with the entry and can be edited later through “History”.

⬇ Сохранение расклада картинкой.title: ⬇ Saving a Spread as an Image
⬇ Сохранение расклада картинкой.text: The down-arrow icon is on the screen of a card, the card of the day and a spread (on the left, above the notepad), and also in “History” next to each entry. Tap it and the app will put together a beautiful image: the spread with the cards, the interpretation, your note, the question and the date. The whole process is shown on screen: first the silhouettes of the cards appear, then the background and frame, the title, the cards, the interpretation and the finishing touches. When everything is ready, a check mark appears with the words “Spread saved to the gallery”. The “Done” button returns you to the spread, and “Share” opens your phone’s menu so you can send the image to a messenger or social networks.

Где найти сохранённую картинку.title: Where to Find the Saved Image
Где найти сохранённую картинку.text: On a phone, images are saved to the gallery, in the “TarotOracle” album (the Pictures/TarotOracle folder). On a computer, they go to the Downloads folder. If you added or changed a note, save the image again: it will contain the current version of the entry.

✕ Вернуться на стартовый экран.title: ✕ Return to the Start Screen
✕ Вернуться на стартовый экран.text: When a spread, a card or the card of the day is open, a ✕ button appears in the right corner of the top bar. Tap it to close the current image and return to the start screen. Your history, notes and the card of the day are kept. If the app was minimized for more than 10 minutes, it also opens on the start screen when you return.

Иконки внизу.title: Icons at the Bottom
Иконки внизу.text: The bottom of the screen holds the quick-access icons: 🂠 Shuffle — restores and reshuffles the deck; 🕒 History — past spreads and cards; 🗂 Deck — the remaining cards and the full list; ⚙ Settings — app settings; 📖 Reading — a summary of the current spread.

🂠 Перемешать.title: 🂠 Shuffle
🂠 Перемешать.text: Restores the deck and shuffles it again. Useful when the cards have run out or you simply want to start over.

🕒 История.title: 🕒 History
🕒 История.text: All past spreads, cards of the day and single draws are saved automatically. You can reopen any entry, add or edit a note, save the entry as an image (the ⬇ icon), and delete the ones you no longer need.

🗂 Колода.title: 🗂 Deck
🗂 Колода.text: Shows how many cards are left in the current deck and in what order they lie after shuffling, as well as the full list of all cards by suit.

⚙ Настройки.title: ⚙ Settings
⚙ Настройки.text: Here you can switch the deck (full or Major Arcana only), choose how cards are drawn, change the app language and find information about the program.

Способ вытягивания карт.title: How Cards Are Drawn
Способ вытягивания карт.text: “In order” draws cards one after another from the already shuffled deck, as when dealing real cards. “Random” picks a card anew from all those remaining each time, regardless of their order in the deck. You can switch the method in “Settings”.

Иконка приложения.title: App Icon
Иконка приложения.text: On your phone’s screen the app appears under the name TarotOracle, with an icon of a golden Tarot card with a star and a moon on a purple background. If the icon or the name did not update after installing a new version, delete the old app and install it again.
